name: Primalist Lithic Lance generation, replacement and resource contract
contract: One hundred real Earthshaping gains sample 20% readiness; capped and blocked attempts do not proc. Readiness temporarily replaces first/highest Geode, survives an out-of-range attempt, consumes on a successful cast, expires and clears on talent removal while preserving a separately learned beam. A beam grants two Earthshaping stacks and twenty Rage.

steps.label: Rage arrives with the damaging missile, after immediate Earthshaping
